preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= wi <= 50 for ui, vi, wi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices within the range [1, n] and has a length between 1 and 50.
The input contains exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.
The starting vertex s for the policeman is within the range [1, n].
The number of criminals is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xj <= n and xj != s for xj in criminals)
preconditions.description: Each criminal's starting vertex is within the range [1, n] and not equal to s.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Terrorists win' or a non-negative integer representing the minimal time to catch all criminals.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Terrorists win' if any(xj == s for xj in criminals) else True
postconditions.description: If any criminal starts at the policeman's initial position, the output is 'Terrorists win'.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'Terrorists win' and int(stdout) == min_time if all_catchable(criminals, s, edges) else stdout == 'Terrorists win'
postconditions.description: If all criminals can be caught, the output is the minimal time required; otherwise, it is 'Terrorists win'.
